response.overview: ​​This short film was co-created with young people, all of whom live in Hull, a city in Northern England which is the least wooded in the whole of the UK. Through poetry and participatory action research, the youth delve into the impact of nature immersion on a five-day Wild Camp with Rewilding Youth has on them.
response.title: Wild Camps

results.name: Wild Camps: A Research Project On Connecting Young People From Urban Areas With Nature
